thread:
Anya (Support): FYI SapphireHealth flagged unexpected 'backup' line items on three invoices after EX-PR-27 rollout. They say backups shouldn't be metered for Dedicated customers.
Elliot (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice snippets? need amounts to prepare credits.
Anya (Support): Paste: 
INV-2027-2101:
- Dedicated reserved capacity: $8,200
- Backup snapshot storage (metered, unexpected): $1,595
INV-2027-2102:
- Dedicated reserved capacity: $8,150
- Backup snapshot storage (metered, unexpected): $1,590
INV-2027-2103:
- Dedicated reserved capacity: $8,300
- Backup snapshot storage (metered, unexpected): $1,600
Total unexpected backup charges across invoices = $4,785
Elliot (Billing Ops): ack. This looks like the EX-PR-27 dynamic-metering toggle mistakenly included backup snapshots for a subset of Dedicated tenants. Product should have excluded Dedicated tiers.
Dev (Product): confirmed — EX-PR-27 gradually enabled dynamic metering for storage tiers; a flag mis-evaluated for Dedicated due to a cohort rule. Ops rolled the flag back but some invoices already generated.
Kaya (Finance): Policy: if platform experiment caused mischarge, issue full goodwill credits and tag as "experiment-induced". Approver required for >$2k — I approve full batch credit of $4,785. Memo: "experiment EX-PR-27 included backup snapshots for Dedicated customers in error; issuing full refund; remedial: add tier-exclusion to rollout checklist".
Elliot (Billing Ops): Creating batched credit commands: 
```
billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2027-2101 --amount 1595 --currency USD --reason "experiment EX-PR-27 mismetered backup snapshots; full goodwill" --approver kaya_finance
billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2027-2102 --amount 1590 --currency USD --reason "experiment EX-PR-27 mismetered backup snapshots; full goodwill" --approver kaya_finance
billing-cli credit create --invoice INV-2027-2103 --amount 1600 --currency USD --reason "experiment EX-PR-27 mismetered backup snapshots; full goodwill" --approver kaya_finance
```
billing-bot: Credit batch submitted: CR-2027-30011, CR-2027-30012, CR-2027-30013 pending approval. Links: https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2027-30011 , https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2027-30012 , https://billing.internal/credits/CR-2027-30013
Elliot (Billing Ops): tagging metadata: experiment=EX-PR-27, affected_tenants=[SapphireHealth], category=experiment-induced
Kaya (Finance): Approved in system. Please ensure each credit note references EX-PR-27 and attach the experiment runbook snapshot.

billing-bot: CR-2027-30012 APPROVED by kaya_finance at 2027-04-03T15:12:22Z. Credit applied: $1,590 to INV-2027-2102.

Anya (Support): Notified SapphireHealth with outreach copy and credit notes. Outreach: "Hi — we found that a pricing experiment (EX-PR-27) accidentally included metering for backup snapshots on Dedicated tenants. We've issued full credits totaling $4,785 across your three invoices and rolled back the flag. Apologies for the disruption; product will follow up with remediation steps." Customer reply: "Thanks for swift handling. Please confirm this won't happen next month." :thumbsup:
Dev (Product): Creating follow-up JIRA BILL-999: add tier-exclusion to experiment rollout checklist, add pre-rollout invoice dry-run, and sweep last 7 days for similar mismetering. Tagging infra, billing, and product.
ops-bot: JIRA BILL-999 created and assigned to product-team at 2027-04-03T15:20:01Z.
Elliot (Billing Ops): I'll run a blind sweep for any other Dedicated tenants billed for backups during EX-PR-27 window and report findings in 24h. Marking these credits as "experiment-induced" in monthly adjustments.
Kaya (Finance): Thanks team. Keep me posted if sweep finds more — escalate to exec ops if cumulative >$25k.
Anya (Support): Closing thread. Outreach copy and credit notes saved to customer folder."
